scripts.translation:
等一下！

scripts.text: Just walk away.
scripts.translation: 直接離開

scripts.text: ^0000FFEden Group^000000 missions?
How can I be a member of the ^0000FFEden Group^000000?
scripts.translation: 如何成為^0000FF樂園團^000000的成員？

scripts.text:
::The Eden Group Missions
::are basically missions
::requested by
::people from all around the kingdom.
::We just categorize them.
scripts.translation:
::樂園團的任務
::基本上是王國各地人們
::提出的委託。
::我們只是負責分類。

scripts.text:
::In the Eden Group,
::we sorted out the missions
::according to the level of difficulty.
::According to this level,
::you can find
::missions that
::suit you.
scripts.translation:
::樂園團會按照任務難度
::對委託進行分類。
::您可以根據等級，
::尋找適合自己的任務。

scripts.text:
::When you are done,
::you can come back
::to the mission board.
scripts.translation:
::完成後，
::您可以回到
::任務板。

scripts.text:
::Then you will be
::rewarded!!
::Simple, isn't it!!
::No commission required!!
scripts.translation:
::然後您將獲得
::獎勵！！
::很簡單，不是嗎！！
::無需手續費！！

scripts.text:
::You can become a member
::of the Eden Group
::to ^0000FFLaime Evenor^000000,
::who is waiting on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
::向在一樓等候的
::^0000FF萊梅·艾文諾^000000申請
::加入樂園團。

scripts.text:
::If you become a member,
::you will get an
::"^006400Eden Group Mark^000000".
::Then you will be able
::to see the mission board.
scripts.translation:
::成為成員後，
::您會獲得
::“^006400樂園團徽章^000000”，
::之後就能檢視任務板了。

scripts.text: You must be within level 86-90 to accept these missions.
scripts.translation: 您的等級必須在86-90級之間才能接受這些任務。
